component.name: Frostread
component.summary: Feeds and a reading list on your own computer

description.p: Frostread follows RSS, Atom and JSON Feed sources, and keeps a list of links to read later. It works on its own: it needs no account, server or other app.

A background service inside the app, readd, polls your feeds, keeps each article as it was sent, and shows a clean copy of it. That copy holds no scripts, and its images come with it, so an article never loads anything from the network when you open it.

Search covers every article. Mark items read, star them, or archive them. Your subscriptions move in and out as OPML, and an article saves as a Markdown file. The readctl command gives scripts the same access.
